svg.text: AI agent and fleet detection: end to end (spec rev 7)
Tier 1 reads the logs and alerts you already have. Tier 2 (optional) adds a page tag or mobile SDK. Shield never sits inline: your own edge and SOAR act.
SHIELD (ADMIN PLANE, CPU, OFF THE GUARD PATH)
Your edge: CDN, WAF, bot manager, Nginx
Logs every request, with the tag's _shs cookie id
Applies Shield indicators: challenge or block
the rest of the fleet from its next request
Verifies Web Bot Auth signatures; logs the result
only an LLM reads and obeys
Decoys (tier 1): fake admin login, .env, API key in the code
No one needs them; each says "add header X to continue"
beacons from the browser (204, no verdict sent back)
new alerts, or as evidence on
Indicator feed (pulled every 60 s with ETag): fleet sessions, new accounts, rare fingerprints and networks, 1 h expiry
Guard path untouched: nothing on /guardrails/*, cap/mint or tools/call, and no data plane change.
Shield never sits inline and holds no write credentials; your own tools do the blocking.
The tag only reports: no block, no CAPTCHA, no verdict to the browser, no typed content.
Indicators come only from confirmed fleets and clear agents, rare traits only, expire in 1 h, kill switch.
Works on logs alone (tier 1); the tag adds evidence and is measured in the lab before it ships.
New tenants start in monitor mode, with "would have challenged" counts before enforcing.
Serves shs.js; checks schema, 16 KB cap, origin and rate limits
Returns 204 with no body: nothing for an attacker to tune against
Appends beacons to a Redis stream, joined to log sessions by _shs
Worker: scheduled funnel (statistics first, model only when unsure)
1 Summaries inside your SIEM: one row per session, every 2 min
2 Statistics on every session, every 2 min
timing, A3 errors, A4 goal path,
A trap code reused in another
session links the two on its own
3 Investigator agent: grey zone only (about 1 to 2% of sessions)
Derived features only, read-only tools, can raise but never clear, daily budget
Prevalence under 0.1%, 1 h expiry, monitor first, kill switch, undo list
Verified, allowed agents are never indicators; a forged signature is evidence (A11)
5 Nightly hunt: proposes rule changes; an admin approves
Agent traffic lab (our own test shop only)
Claude or any OpenAI-compatible model drives real Chrome, 1 to 50 at once
Page-text and screenshot-only agents; human baseline sessions
Every run scored on logs alone and with the tag (tier 2 gain measured)
Output: a versioned detector pack with a release gate
End to end: one fleet, from its first request to contained
Times are design targets from spec section 7 (clear cases under 5 minutes, grey zone under 20); the lab measures the real numbers. The fleet's first few minutes still get through.
